usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the CSV parser in `main.wj`. When I ran it compiled on your two examples, joined into one input, the output matched the expected output.

It reads standard input and parses each line character by character, tracking whether it is inside quotes. A `""` inside a quoted field becomes a literal `"`. It handles an empty line as one empty field, and it prints `<n>: [f1]|[f2]|...` for each record
